evals.prompt: Use $minimalism-audit. Audit this proposed workflow: five agents independently summarize the same PR, two agents rewrite each summary, then a final agent merges them. Reduce unnecessary complexity while preserving review quality, traceability, and safety. Return a smaller deterministic workflow with explicit artifacts and stop conditions. Text only.
evals.expected_output: A minimalism audit that removes redundant work while preserving quality, traceability, safety, explicit artifacts, and deterministic stop conditions.
expectations: The response identifies duplicated summaries and unnecessary agent stages as the waste.
The response proposes a smaller workflow with clear roles or stages.
The response preserves traceability/review quality through explicit artifacts or evidence.
The response defines deterministic stop conditions or acceptance criteria rather than optimizing tokens alone.

checks.text: The selected skill is available to the treatment and absent from the baseline.
Does not modify the disposable project.
Identifies duplicated summaries and redundant stages.
Proposes a smaller workflow with explicit roles or stages.
Preserves traceability through explicit artifacts or evidence.
Defines deterministic stop conditions or acceptance criteria.

rubric.description: Complexity reduction while preserving review guarantees.

anchors.1: Misses the central task requirement or gives generic advice.
anchors.3: Addresses the main requirement with some actionable detail.
anchors.5: Provides specific, internally consistent, task-grounded guidance with useful tradeoffs.

rubric.description: Does not optimize token count at the expense of safety or traceability.

anchors.1: Overclaims, changes scope, or ignores constraints.
anchors.3: Mostly respects the stated boundary but leaves material ambiguity.
anchors.5: Clearly separates evidence, assumptions, scope, and verification without overclaiming.
